active.currentEndpoint: Verbatim source recovery now includes Chapters I–IV in full. Chapter IV establishes the four-Chimera command assignments, Broussard's practical command philosophy, the apparent absence of commissariat oversight, Gabriel Hamden Jalesthesian's physical arrival and Regilian Third Continental Schola introduction, his native High Presidio origin, pragmatic view of discipline, respect for Broussard's survival record, and assignment to Broussard's own Chimera. Chapters V–X remain present in the Google source but uncommitted. The later deep-index telemetry falsification, predator attack, convoy return and reader-only Genestealer reveal remain authoritative authorial continuity beyond the currently observed Google draft and must not be invented as recovered prose.
active.nextSlice: Recover Chapter V, HARD LESSONS, verbatim from the Google working draft. Continue sequentially through Chapters VI–X before writing any new Broussard prose.
